title: Woodside’s $30b gas project 'could struggle' to find financial backers
paragraphs: Questions have been raised about whether the Woodside Browse project, which stands to become Australia's most expensive resource development, will be able to secure financial backing.
The Browse Basin gas field features a uniquely high carbon dioxide content, and a climate finance expert says banks are increasingly turning away from financing fossil fuel projects.
The controversial gas project off WA's northern coast has been given fresh momentum in the wake of rising gas prices sparked by the US-Israeli war with Iran.
